financial-total.purpose: The most important total in the active transaction.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Charcoal default for generic high-priority actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { height: 36px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; padding: 0 16px; border: 1px solid var(--primary); border-radius: var(--radius-control); background: var(--primary); color: var(--on-primary); font: 600 14px/1.2 var(--font-sans); transition: background-color 150ms var(--ease-out), border-color 150ms var(--ease-out); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--primary-hover); border-color: var(--primary-hover); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--primary-focus); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { cursor: not-allowed; opacity: 0.5; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Standard secondary action with a solid neutral boundary.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { height: 36px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid var(--border-frame); border-radius: var(--radius-control); background: var(--surface-1); color: var(--ink); font: 500 14px/1.2 var(--font-sans); transition: background-color 150ms var(--ease-out), border-color 150ms var(--ease-out); } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: var(--surface-2); border-color: var(--border-strong); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--primary-focus); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Labeled 36px field for forms and command bars.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 6px; color: var(--ink); font-family: var(--font-sans); } .ds-field-label { font-size: 12px; line-height: 1.25; font-weight: 600; } .ds-input { width: 100%; height: 36px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid var(--border-frame); border-radius: var(--radius-control); background: var(--surface-1); color: var(--ink); font: 400 14px/1.4 var(--font-sans); transition: border-color 150ms var(--ease-out), box-shadow 150ms var(--ease-out); } .ds-input:hover { border-color: var(--border-strong); } .ds-input:focus { border-color: var(--brand); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--primary-focus); outline: none; }

components.name: Compact Card
components.description: Default framed working surface for dense application content.
components.css: .ds-card { display: grid; gap: 12px; padding: 12px; border: 1px solid var(--border-standard); border-radius: var(--radius-panel); background: var(--surface-1); color: var(--ink); font-family: var(--font-sans); } .ds-card-header { display: flex; align-items: baseline; justify-content: space-between; gap: 12px; } .ds-card-header h3 { margin: 0; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -0.02em; } .ds-card-header span { color: var(--ink-muted); font-size: 12px; } .ds-card-value { font-size: 22px; line-height: 1.1; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; letter-spacing: -0.02em; }

components.name: Active Navigation Row
components.description: Compact active route treatment using the graphite selection family.
components.html: Home
components.css: .ds-nav-row { height: 40px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 0 8px; border-radius: var(--radius-control); background: var(--selection); color: var(--selection-foreground); border: 1px solid var(--selection-border); font: 600 14px/1.2 var(--font-sans); text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 150ms var(--ease-out); } .ds-nav-row svg { width: 18px; height: 18px; flex: none; } .ds-nav-row:hover { background: var(--selection); } .ds-nav-row:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--brand); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Transaction Type Chips
components.description: Neutral category labels for sales and estimates; semantic color is reserved for status.
components.css: .ds-chip-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; font-family: var(--font-sans); } .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 24px; padding: 2px 8px; border: 1px solid; border-radius: var(--radius-control); font-size: 12px; line-height: 1.2; font-weight: 600; } .ds-chip-sale, .ds-chip-estimate { color: var(--ink-muted); border-color: var(--border-frame); background: var(--surface-1); }

components.name: Dense Table Row
components.description: Stable 42px data row with protected numeric alignment.
components.html: Amul Gold Milk 1L2 × ₹72.00₹144.00
components.css: .ds-table-row { min-height: 42px; display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) minmax(110px, auto) minmax(100px, auto); align-items: center; gap: 12px; padding: 0 12px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-standard); background: var(--surface-1); color: var(--ink); font: 400 14px/1.25 var(--font-sans); } .ds-table-row:hover { background: var(--surface-2); } .ds-table-row:focus-within { background: var(--selection); outline: 2px solid var(--selection-border); outline-offset: -2px; } .ds-table-name { min-width: 0; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-table-meta { color: var(--ink-muted); text-align: right; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-table-row strong { text-align: right; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

components.name: Billing Summary Bar
components.description: Stable transaction footer with an anchored total and dominant workflow action.
components.css: .ds-summary { height: 52px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: flex-end; gap: 12px; padding: 0 12px; border-top: 1px solid var(--border-frame); background: var(--surface-1); color: var(--ink); font-family: var(--font-sans); } .ds-total { display: flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 6px; min-width: 0; } .ds-total span { color: var(--ink-muted); font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; } .ds-total strong { font-size: 22px; line-height: 1.1; font-weight: 700; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; letter-spacing: -0.02em; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-summary-action { height: 40px; padding: 0 16px; border: 1px solid var(--primary); border-radius: var(--radius-control); background: var(--primary); color: var(--on-primary); font: 600 14px/1.2 var(--font-sans); } .ds-summary-action:hover { background: var(--primary-hover); border-color: var(--primary-hover); } .ds-summary-action:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--primary-focus); outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview: QuickCart is a compact, keyboard-and-mouse point-of-sale workspace for repeated shop-counter operation. Crisp white working surfaces, a cool-neutral canvas, strong charcoal actions, clear graphite selection, and solid borders make the interface feel stable and trustworthy. Density is intentional: common tasks stay visible, financial values are easy to compare, and geometry remains fixed while data changes.
keyCharacteristics: Compact without shrinking text or interaction targets
Neutral working surfaces with solid structural borders
Charcoal generic actions and explicit graphite selection
Permanent labeled identities for sales and estimates
Tabular financial data and stable column geometry
Keyboard parity for every billing-critical action
Screen and print themes kept intentionally separate

rules.name: Stable Geometry
rules.body: Primary actions, totals, table columns, and navigation remain in predictable locations across content states.

rules.name: Semantic Color
rules.body: Charcoal means action, graphite means focus or selection, green means completed or saved, amber means partial or warning, and red means due, error, or destructive. Categories remain neutral.

rules.name: Borders Before Shadows
rules.body: Working surfaces use solid borders; shadows communicate overlays and stacking rather than importance.

rules.name: Keyboard Parity
rules.body: Anything required to create, edit, save, print, or recover a bill is reachable and understandable without a mouse.

rules.name: Print Isolation
rules.body: Receipt and A4 output use invoice-only tokens so screen-theme changes cannot reduce print legibility.

dos: Use semantic tokens and the established density contract.
Keep frequent controls visible and stable.
Design long-name, large-amount, loading, empty, error, and focus states.
Update virtualizer estimates with row-height changes.
Validate the baseline viewport at 100% zoom.
donts: Do not use zoom or transform scaling as a layout system.
Do not use blue as the generic primary action color.
Do not hide billing-critical controls behind overflow menus.
Do not rely on hover or color alone for essential state.
Do not let screen colors leak into invoice output.
